title: STVGBert: A Visual-Linguistic Transformer Based Framework for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: STVGBert: A Visual-Linguistic Transformer Based Framework for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize a spatio-temporal tube of a target object in an untrimmed video based on a query sentence.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Specifically, without resorting to pre-generated object proposals, our STVGBert directly takes a video and a query sentence as the input, and then produces the cross-modal features by using the newly introduced cross-modal feature learning module ST-ViLBert.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: Comprehensive experiments demonstrate our newly proposed framework outperforms the state-of-the-art multi-stage methods on two benchmark datasets Vid-STG and HC-STVG. # Abstract Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize a spatio-temporal tube of a target object in an untrimmed video based on a query sentence.
